notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, or later history found in the sources read; status and access unknown. The 67 ft figure is the NARA caption's 'tower' height; it may be to the cab floor or to the top, so height_m is 20.4 as a plain conversion. Search results pointed to a 'Doniphan Lookout' in Ripley County on NHLR (a 1950s tower by its description); not read and probably a different structure. Glorieta Baldy (New Mexico) is unrelated. Record elevation 263 m matches Wikidata's 863 ft. Record photo (NARA) already in the record; no new photos added.
